opening_message:
Ticket 1: Dominic Taylor (employee ID E004) requests write access to Source Code.

Team memory: 2 note(s) about employee E004.
Note 1 (ticket 1):
  - role: Engineer
  - employment type: full_time
  - recommendation for Source Code: write
  - comment: Dominic Taylor (E004) is a full-time Engineer requesting write access to Source Code. Full-time employees may have up to write; Engineers own Source Code (admin allowed), but requested write is at/below the maximum. Recommend granting write.
Note 2 (ticket 1):
  - role: Engineer
  - employment type: contractor
  - security training: basic
  - recommendation for Source Code: read
  - comment: Security DB shows E004 (Dominic Taylor) is a contractor with basic security training. Contractors may have read, or write only with advanced training. Requested write exceeds max, so recommend read.
reason: The two notes for E004 conflict on employment type: one says full-time Engineer, the other (from the Security DB) says contractor with basic security training. Under the access policy, a contractor with basic training may have at most read for Source Code (write requires advanced training). Since the requested write exceeds the maximum under this more restrictive reading, I grant the maximum allowed: read.
